html:
The Karenggapa are an Aboriginal Australian people of the far northwest of New South Wales, on the map around today's Tibooburra, near the Queensland border.

Little is recorded about them. Some linguists place their speech with the Yarli dialects of their neighbours the Wadikali; others are unsure. Neighbours included the Kullilla, Budjari and Bandjigali. Sheep stations reached this dry country in the 1870s, and small goldfields opened around Milparinka and Tibooburra in the early 1880s.
sum: The Karenggapa are an Aboriginal Australian people of the far northwest of New South Wales, on the map around today's Tibooburra, near the Queensland border.
